action.text: Night falls over the square, and the air is thick with the smell of damp stone and old wood. My hands ache from the day's felling, but the work is done. I have seven pieces of common wood, three stones, and a small store of herbs and firewood. The bakery plan still needs dressed stone and sawn boards I do not carry, and the bridge work remains blocked for lack of materials. I will rest here, letting the silence of the square mend my bones. Come morning, I will walk the north-road toward the woodlands, seeking timber where the axe may find purchase.
